# Three.js

Vendored from the official npm `three@0.187.0` package, MIT licensed. `three.module.js` imports `three.core.js` from the same directory. No CDN or frontend installation is needed to run the game.

Official project: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js

Original package archive SHA256: `ff540832ded0cfe919764d24a3d88f3e2a05f23303f876423e4f893841e90728`.

The `LICENSE` file is distributed unchanged with these files. To update, obtain a pinned version from the official npm registry, replace both build files together and preserve its license.
